# Framegrove

> Free, open-source, local-first store marketing editor. Create App Store Creative Assets, iPhone Duo inner/outer screenshots and App Store/Google Play screenshot series from real app captures. No signup or watermark.

Website UI: EN, TR, DE, FR, ES, IT, PT, JA. Project captions: 34 languages. Current templates: 56 curated collections/compositions. The authoritative MCP catalog is `list_templates`.

## Product
- [Product overview](https://framegrove.bamstudio.dev/index.md): Capabilities, local storage, languages and scope.
- [Template collections](https://framegrove.bamstudio.dev/templates/index.md): Template keys, surfaces and composition choices.
- [iPhone Duo](https://framegrove.bamstudio.dev/iphone-duo/index.md): Exact screenshot dimensions, separate display slots and upload availability.
- [Apple Creative Assets](https://framegrove.bamstudio.dev/creative-assets/index.md): Header, Search and Universal artwork specifications.

## Automation
- [MCP and CLI](https://framegrove.bamstudio.dev/mcp/index.md): npx installation, tool schema overview and examples.
- [Framegrove skill](https://framegrove.bamstudio.dev/skills/framegrove/SKILL.md): Reusable workflow for coherent, truthful campaigns and visual review.

## Policies
- [Privacy and usage](https://framegrove.bamstudio.dev/privacy/index.md): Local projects, optional AI and commercial use.
